messages.author: 6667ef04b386b9ec
messages.subject: Output order of correlation estimates
parts:
Hi there. I want to clarify how to index the correlation/theta estimates, that is, which correlation corresponds to each pair of variables.

Context: I adjusted a multivariate Poisson model (with 5 response variables) via random effects approach, and I want to know the correlation estimates between each pair of variable.

Method1 - Via theta matrix
obj <- MakeADFun(...)
fit_NLB <- nlminb(...)      
And I obtain these values for theta:

After that, I just pass the vector to matrix to create the "L"  matrix as https://kaskr.github.io/adcomp/classdensity_1_1UNSTRUCTURED__CORR__t.html:

In order to obtain the true correlation parameters, I use (as previous link):
middle <- L %*% t(L)    # Where L is the previous matrix
D <- diag(middle)
Dinvsqrt <- diag(1/sqrt(D))
Dinvsqrt %*% recheio %*% Dinvsqrt
And I obtain:

This is the correlation matrix "by hand".
Method2 - Via sdreport()
rep <- sdreport(obj) #(After optimization)
rep_cor <- summary(rep, "report")

After that, I just need to organize it into a matrix:

(I include the estimates and (standard error)). To obtain this matrix, I kept only the unique values, and correlations of one variable to another (excluding those who had value of 1). And then, I fulfill the matrix in the same order as it is shown in the UNSTRUCTURED_CORR_t documentation.

Clearly, one of them is wrong (I obtain the same values, but the order differs).
So, what is my mistake?
(I also attached the full code and functions if needed).
Thanks in advance.

messages.subject: Re: Output order of correlation estimates
parts:
Tks Hans.

This is exactly my doubt. I may be mixing the order (of elements) when I convert the output of rep_cor to the correlation matrix. If I am doing this, what is the correct order of the elements?. Is the final result of method 1 right and method 2 wrong?
It would be nice if the row.names(rep_cor) were labelled something like cor_Y1_Y2, cor_Y1_Y3... But I can do this by myself, as long as I know the correct output order..

Thanks again!

messages.author: e97222832aa0e335
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Re: Output order of correlation estimates
parts:
Try this:

mat=matrix(nrow=5,ncol=5);
r=0;
for (col in 1:5){
  for (row in 1:5) {
     r=r+1;
     mat[row,col]=rep_cor[r,1];#--getting the estimates from 1st column of rep_cor
  }
}

That should get you the estimated values from rep_cor in the same order as in your "by hand" version.
I think the following will work, as well, but with a bit less code:

mat=matrix(rep_cor[[,1],nrow=5,ncol=5,byrow=FALSE);

Note the above fills in the whole matrix. You'll have to zero out the elements above the diagonal yourself.

Hope this helps.
